quote: When authorized markers, buttons, or other indications are placed within an intersection indicating the course to be traveled by vehicles turning thereat, no driver of a vehicle shall disobey the direction of such indications.

activation.condition: Authorized markers, buttons or other indications are placed within an intersection and indicate the course for vehicles turning there.

obligation.description: A driver turning there shall not disobey the direction of those indications.

timing.description: The indication governs the complete turn through the intersection; retain entry, turn and exit frames.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: authorized markers, buttons, or other indications
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain original authority and in-intersection placement readback; municipal authorization remains a source review question.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: disobey the direction of such indications
judgment_calls_needed.note: Retain the full original body path and sourced indicated course; no numeric legal deviation cutoff is supplied.

parameter_refs.name: indication_form
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: authorized marker, button or other indication with original site source

parameter_refs.name: turn_course
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: indicated or divergent course target; realized body path measured independently
